Someone who receives baptism on a sickbed.
ex: We are all Clinicks in this point
Clinic baptism is all that is contemplated by them, and even in this case a clinic was, unless in unusual cases, debarred from orders.

ety.text: From the Late Latin clīnicus (“a bed-ridden person”, “one baptized on a sick-bed”, “a physician”).
Borrowed from French clinique, ultimately from Ancient Greek κλινική (klinikḗ).

chain.g: a physician who tends to patients who are bedridden

ety.text: Learned borrowing from Latin clīnicē, from Ancient Greek κλινική (klinikḗ).
